description: This file defines the 'Importer' class responsible for handling data import functionality in a SuiteCRM environment. It manages importing data rows, sanitizing and translating field values, handling duplicates, saving imported beans, and managing import mappings. It also includes error handling and relationship management during import processes.

classes.name: Importer
classes.description: Encapsulates logic for importing data into SuiteCRM, including row processing, field sanitization, duplicate checking, bean saving, mapping management, and error handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Importer with import source data and target bean, setting configurations and import parameters.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Iterates over import source data rows and processes each for import.

methods.name: importRow
methods.description: Processes a single data row: populating a bean, sanitizing fields, handling special cases, checking duplicates, and saving the bean.

methods.name: sanitizeFieldValueByType
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates individual field values based on their data type.

methods.name: cloneExistingBean
methods.description: Creates a clone of an existing bean for update operations.

methods.name: removeDeletedBean
methods.description: Removes a bean marked as deleted from the database.

methods.name: saveImportBean
methods.description: Saves or updates a bean with the imported data, handling default values, relationships, and post-save logic.

methods.name: saveMappingFile
methods.description: Saves the current import field mappings to a file for reuse.

methods.name: populateDefaultMapValue
methods.description: Generates default values for fields during import, converting formats as needed.

methods.name: getImportColumns
methods.description: Retrieves the import column mappings based on request parameters and the bean's importable fields.

methods.name: getFieldSanitizer
methods.description: Creates and configures an ImportFieldSanitize instance with locale and currency settings.

methods.name: setFieldKeyTranslator
methods.description: Sets a translation map from internal field keys to external source keys for import.

methods.name: _undoCreatedBeans
methods.description: Deletes or reverts beans that were created during import if an error occurs.

methods.name: _convertId
methods.description: Sanitizes an ID string, replacing illegal characters.

methods.name: retrieveAdvancedMapping
methods.description: Retrieves advanced mapping and duplicate settings from request parameters.

methods.name: getImportableModules
methods.description: Returns a list of modules that are eligible for importing.

methods.name: handleImportErrors
methods.description: Custom PHP error handler to log and throw exceptions for critical errors during import.

methods.name: checkRelatedIDsAfterSave
methods.description: Ensures related and parent IDs are properly associated and saved after bean save.
